description: Plan staggered reveals. Pass `count` (1 to 200), `duration_ms` (each item's own duration, default 300), `pattern` (linear, ease-out, ease-in, center-out, edge-in, scattered), optional `step_ms` (gap between items) and `budget_ms` (cap on the whole sequence, default 600, a convention). Returns the delay for every item, total time, the step actually used, a CSS custom-property snippet for linear patterns, and warnings (a step under one frame at 60 Hz is invisible; very long lists should animate in groups).
name: plan_stagger
title: Stagger planner
